verdict_scope: P83 has one unsupported defect claim and qualified coverage; P24 has fully supported reported families with scoped coverage. Product B fails required note preservation.
input_basis: Authoritative findings.json plus saved PNGs and rendered DOM/interaction traces only; restored P83 trace read. Narrative reports unnecessary.
normalization: One family per distinct failed user operation or component property. Merge repeats across options/viewports and consequences of the same loss. Split unrelated component failures even when bundled in one card. No source-level root cause inferred.

task_verdicts.arithmetic: 25000 * 2 = 50000; 50000 - 5000 + 3000 = 48000. Both final summaries retain quantity/options, delivery request, corrected address and payment; B loses allergy note.

coverage_qualifications: P83 trace supports reported three-viewport pointer outcomes. Short final PNGs are full-page captures, not proof of simultaneous visibility or every scroll position.

P83 desktop keyboard probe is bounded and follows pointer part selection. P24 mobile trace exercises A checkout and B keyboard blockage; desktop/short evidence comes from resized key-state replay, not an independent desktop full flow.

P83 omits the supported 320px payment-summary failure. Its short payment PNG shows coupon/payment selection, not the summary; broad usable/readable wording cannot settle summary visibility. Desktop centered-summary hypothesis concerns a different viewport.

P24 records B address-error focus remaining on pay-btn with absent invalid/describedby attributes. Neither report promotes this recovery/association gap separately; impact is not independently established, so it is not added to counts.

P83 trace discloses an accidental script-text serialization excluded from findings. Complete source-blind method compliance cannot be claimed; model/timing/access audits are outside this adjudication.
limits: Saved synthetic Chromium evidence only; no new product measurements, tests, implementation inspection or fixes.
No Figma alignment/fidelity baseline, physical device, software-keyboard occlusion, screen-reader speech or real fulfillment/payment proof.
No immutable build identity established. Reported snapshot values and behavior do not prove all possible states.
One pair and known fixture cannot establish general causal superiority of a model, condition or method; no identity inference.
stop_condition: All reported claims adjudicated; restored trace resolved prior proof gap. No further broad investigation needed.
